article.headline: Claim Closed at 12.7: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Leaves Black Friday Still at 83%
paras: The Black Friday doorbusters are over, folks, and the adjuster has stamped the file. [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] went the distance: 15 carries for 26 yards and eight catches for 46 more, good for 12.7 points. It was the only real money anyone in our league banked today, and it all went to [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]].

Last chapter asked Coleman to turn a fender-bender into a total loss. He got the fourth quarter he needed for 5.3 more points, but the car is still drivable. outsiderightfoot climbs to 40.8, still last of seven, and the Chop% barely blinked: it sits at 83. The projected gap to [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] narrows to 19.8 points, a dent, not a rescue.

Elsewhere the mall stayed closed. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] scraped together 1.0 point, and the rest of the field, SkyWalker, [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]], [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]], [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] and [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnom]], didn't ring up a thing. Nobody got hurt, nobody got paid, and the leaderboard went home with its leftovers.

Up in orbit, SkyWalker is still parked at 15.6 with all five starters on the launch pad, projected to land at 104.4 and a 13% Chop%. ZynFree hasn't scored at all and doesn't care: seven starters to come, projected to finish 127.5.

So the case goes to Sunday. outsiderightfoot sends [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] and [[p:8144|Chris Olave (WR, NO, #12)]] into the early games, with a tight end on Sunday night, projected to finish at 84.6. To flip this saga, Henry and Olave need to file the kind of claim that bankrupts the insurer, or the rocket needs a launch-pad explosion. Until then, the policy stays in force and the axe stays sharpened.

articles.headline: The church crowd tumbles to seventh, but [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] still holds the cellar key
paras: Sunday's early games moved the furniture at the bottom, but [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] is still in the basement. [[p:12526|Tetairoa McMillan (WR, CAR, #4)]] caught a touchdown for 18.1 points, and the Chop% fell from 46 to 35. Still the highest in the league. Thursday's funny game is still funny.

The turn came from the pews. [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] slid from fourth to seventh, and its Chop% jumped 18 points to 21, just 0.7 points behind ZynFree on the board. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] hit turbulence too, up to 27%. And [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] finally broke the round zero: [[p:7594|Chuba Hubbard (RB, CAR, #30)]] carried 27 times for two touchdowns and 29.0 points. Hockey Guy holds at 15%, right where Thursday left it.

Tonight the congregation prays to [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]], projected for 20.9. A Christian to save the Christians. ZynFree still waits on [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] Monday night, projected for 23.1. Our projected finals: ZynFree 92.9, the church 96.3. One big Sunday night, and the cellar door swings.

articles.headline: The cellar key changes hands: [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] drops to the basement
paras: There it is. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] climbed the stairs and handed the cellar key to the church. [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] sits dead last at 55.8, and its Chop% leapt 19 points to 41. ZynFree eased to 31%. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] breathes easier at 9%, with just one Sunday night quarterback left to play.

The turn came as a trickle, not a flood. The church scraped together 0.3 points in the last hour, while [[p:12481|Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG, #44)]] has 3 yards on 4 carries. ZynFree's [[p:8146|Garrett Wilson (WR, NYJ, #5)]] carried 3.5 into halftime, just enough to climb a rung. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] found smoother air too, down to 18%.

Now the squeeze. Our projected finals: the church 89.5, ZynFree 91.0. Tonight the pews still pray to [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]], projected for 20.9. ZynFree answers Monday night with [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]], projected for 23.1. A Christian to save the Christians is no longer a joke. It's the whole plan.

articles.headline: Three tenths of a point: the cellar race goes to a photo finish
paras: Hold your hats. [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] still holds the cellar key at 60.6, but the church found a few coins in the collection plate. Its Chop% slipped 2 points to 39. Upstairs, [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] sits at 64.0 and felt the draft from the basement door: its Chop% jumped 5 to 36. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] skated up a rung to 7%, and [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] cruises at 18%.

The turn was a crawl, not a sprint. [[p:12481|Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG, #44)]] chipped in 4.8 points the hard way, 17 yards on 9 carries plus a few catches. ZynFree's [[p:8146|Garrett Wilson (WR, NYJ, #5)]] added just 2.9, and the clock in his game is running out.

Now the photo finish. Our projected finals: the church 88.5, ZynFree 88.8. That's three tenths of a point, about one short catch. Tonight the pews still pray to [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]], projected for 20.9. ZynFree answers Monday night with [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]], projected for 23.1. Whoever's savior blinks first takes the stairs down.

articles.headline: Photo finish no more: a fumble widens the cellar gap
paras: Last chapter it was three tenths of a point. Not anymore. [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] went backwards, 1.6 points into the red, and now sits at 59.0. Its Chop% jumped 25 points to 64. Upstairs, [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] never moved off 64.0, yet watched its Chop% drop 11 to 25. Sometimes the best play is standing still while the neighbor trips.

The trip had a name. [[p:12481|Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG, #44)]] lost a fumble, and the collection plate came up lighter. He has 3.5 with Q4 8:29 left to make amends. Further up, [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] sits at 9% and [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] has skated down to 3%.

Our projected finals now: the church 81.8, ZynFree 87.1. That's a 5-point gap, a touchdown drive short of a coin flip. Tonight the pews need [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]], projected for 20.9, to beat his number. ZynFree waits for Monday night and [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]], projected for 23.1. If McCaffrey runs hot under the Sunday night lights, the photo comes back into focus.

articles.headline: Late bell rings with the church projected for the chop, Sunday night left to pray
paras: The late games are in the books, and the pews stayed on the bottom. [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] closed the session at 60.8, still 3.2 behind [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]], which spent the whole afternoon parked at 64.0. The church sits at 64% to be chopped. ZynFree slid to 24%.

Those amends we asked for? [[p:12481|Cam Skattebo (RB, NYG, #44)]] found 1.8 more points to finish at 5.3. A coin in the plate, not a miracle. Up the ladder, [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] idles on the launch pad at 51.0 and 10%, while [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] holds at 79.3 and 2%.

So the church is projected for the block, 81.7 against ZynFree's 87.1. The photo comes back into focus only if [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]], projected for 20.9, runs hot under the Sunday night lights. Then ZynFree hands the whole thing to Monday night and [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]], projected for 23.1. Two prayers, two nights, one axe.

articles.headline: The prayer starts slow: [[t:MayebachMusic10|the church]] climbs to 86% under the Sunday lights
paras: Sunday night opened, and the collection plate came back nearly empty. [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]] has 3 carries for 8 yards, good for 0.8 points. That lifts [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] to 61.6, still 2.4 behind [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]]. The church's Chop% jumped 22 points to 86%. ZynFree, still parked at 64.0 without lifting a finger, dropped to 10%.

The rest of the field got its engines warm. [[p:6794|Justin Jefferson (WR, MIN, #18)]] caught one for 29 yards, and [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] drifted up to 54.9 and 4%. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] got 3.2 from Jefferson's teammate under center and sits at 82.5, all but out of the chop chase.

It's Q1 1:28, and the miracle is running late. McCaffrey is now projected for 15.5, and the church is projected to finish at 76.3 against ZynFree's 87.1. To flip the next chapter, McCaffrey needs a big quarter, fast, and then ZynFree has to sweat out [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] on Monday night. The pews are full. The plate is waiting.

articles.headline: The plate fills, the odds don't: [[t:MayebachMusic10|the church]] passes ZynFree and still sits at 89%
paras: A little something landed in the collection plate. [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]] is up to 9 carries for 40 yards, and [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] climbed to 65.8. That's 1.8 points clear of [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]], who still hasn't moved off 64.0. The church leads on the scoreboard tonight, and its Chop% still went up, to 89%.

Here's the catch. ZynFree has [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] waiting for Monday night, projected for 23.1, and ZynFree's Chop% slid to 6%. The church has one prayer left, and it's already halfway through its sermon. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] drifted to 56.2 and 5%, with a quarterback still in the hangar for Monday. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] crept to 83.1, mostly watching from the rink.

It's Q2 0:03, and the halftime hymn is about to play. McCaffrey is projected for 14.1, and the church is projected to finish at 75.0 against ZynFree's 87.1. To flip the next chapter, McCaffrey needs a second half for the stained glass, about 12 more points than projected, before Daniels ever takes a snap. The pews are still full. The plate needs a lot more.

articles.headline: A touchdown in the collection plate: [[t:MayebachMusic10|the church]] gets its miracle, falls to 74%
paras: Somebody up there was listening. [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]] punched in a touchdown, and [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] jumped 9.2 points to 75.0, eleven clear of [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]]. The church's Chop% dropped 14 points, to 74%. Still the back pew, but the hymnals are finally open.

The rest of the bottom felt the draft. ZynFree still hasn't moved off 64.0, and its Chop% doubled to 13%. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] got 72 receiving yards from [[p:6794|Justin Jefferson (WR, MIN, #18)]], plus a lost fumble that rattled the cockpit, and floats at 59.3 and 12%. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] sits at 85.5, close to 0%, watching from the penalty box.

It's Q4 13:26 in San Francisco. McCaffrey is projected for 18.7, and the church is projected to finish at 79.5 against ZynFree's 87.0 and Kenny's 88.2. To flip the next chapter, McCaffrey needs about 8 points more than projected before the fourth quarter runs out. If not, it all comes down to Monday night, when [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] and Kenny's quarterback in the hangar decide whether the miracle holds.

articles.headline: No second miracle: [[t:MayebachMusic10|the church]] rests at 75.0 and prays for a Monday flop
paras: The collection plate came back light. After that touchdown, [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] finished the day right where the last chapter left it: 75.0 points, every starter done. With nothing left to add, the church's Chop% climbed 20 points to 95%. The hymnals are open. Now the congregation prays for a quiet Monday night.

The rest of the bottom had a rough Sunday too. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] scored 49.7 today, the fewest in the league, and still sits at 64.0. Its running back went down on a play and came back. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] added 57.0 and drifts at 62.2, that lost fumble still rattling around the cockpit.

[[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] skated off at 87.7, done for the week and safe at 0%. The hero was [[p:7594|Chuba Hubbard (RB, CAR, #30)]]: 27 carries, 120 yards, two touchdowns, 29.0 points. Not bad for a guy who wandered into a football game.

Up top, nobody is sweating. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] leads at 139.3. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] rode [[p:3294|Dak Prescott (QB, DAL, #4)]] to the line of the day: 325 passing yards and five total touchdowns for 36.9 points. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] sits at 88.6 with Monday help to come, though its receiver was hurt on a play, returned, and is now listed Questionable.

So it comes down to Monday night, just as promised. [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] is projected for 23.0 and needs a little over 11 to lift ZynFree past the church. [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] is projected for 25.6 and needs about 13 to fly Kenny clear. For now, the church is projected to be chopped. Two quarterbacks, one back pew, and a whole lot of praying.

articles.headline: Kickoff at the chapel: two quarterbacks, one pew, and [[t:MayebachMusic10|the church]] at 95%
paras: The organ has gone quiet. [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] still sits at 75.0, every starter done, and its Chop% crept up to 95%. The congregation has nothing left to give. It can only kneel, watch Monday night, and hope two quarterbacks stumble on the way to the altar.

The ball is in the air, Q1 at 15:00, and nobody has scored yet. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] waits at 64.0 with [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]], projected for 23.1. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] idles on the launch pad at 62.2, its whole flight plan resting on [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]], projected for 25.9. Up the ladder, [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] and [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] have Monday help too, but they are just here for the hymns.

Here is the sermon. Daniels needs a little over 11 to lift ZynFree past the church. Burrow needs about 13 to get Kenny into orbit. Both are projected to clear it, which is why the church is projected to be chopped. But one bad night under center, one quarterback who can't find the end zone, and the collection plate gets passed to somebody new.

articles.headline: The church gets its miracle as [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] slides into the last pew
paras: The sermon took a turn. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] has crept to just 64.7, and with [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] frozen at 75.0, the two traded places. ZynFree now sits last at a 48% Chop%. The church's Chop% plunged 57 points. Somebody in the choir is weeping with joy.

Blame a sluggish Q2. [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] is 4 of 6 for 25 yards, with two carries for minus 3, good for 0.7 points. Meanwhile [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] went 14 of 21 for 104 yards, pushing [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] to 66.3. The rocket is off the pad, though not yet in orbit.

Q2, 3:02, and the math is simple. Daniels needs 10.3 more to lift ZynFree past the church. Burrow needs 8.7 more to put Kenny clear. Kenny is projected to make it. ZynFree is projected for 74.8, a hair short of the pew in front. One Daniels scramble could pass the collection plate right back.

articles.headline: One scramble later, the collection plate swings back to the church
paras: The plate went right back. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] climbed 9.1 to 73.8. It still trails [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]]'s frozen 75.0 on the board, but it's projected for 81.4. The church is projected last again, its Chop% back up 58 points to 95%. The choir has stopped weeping. The choir is packing hymnals.

The scramble arrived on cue. [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] has run four times for 54 yards on top of 85 through the air, good for 9.8. On the other sideline, [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] has 233 yards and two touchdowns, lifting [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] 13.1 to 79.4. The rocket has cleared the atmosphere, projected for 89.1.

Q3, 7:04. Daniels needs just 1.3 more to pass the church outright, and the church has nobody left to answer. Burrow needs 8.4 more to leapfrog [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]], done for the week at 87.7. Torn-Again Christian's only hope now is a ZynFree collapse. Pray hard.

articles.headline: The hymnals are packed: [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] hits 100% Chop
paras: Pray hard, we said. The prayers bounced. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] added 6.6 and sits at 80.4, a clean 5.4 clear of [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]]'s frozen 75.0. The church's Chop% ticked up the last 5 points to 100%. The choir isn't packing hymnals anymore. The hymnals are in the van.

[[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] did exactly what the plate needed. He's 22 of 33 for 247 yards, with 55 more on the ground, good for 16.4. Across the field, [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] has 300 yards and two touchdowns, and [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] has climbed to 82.1. The rocket made orbit. It just never caught [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]], parked at 87.7.

Q4, 0:23. Burrow would need 5.6 more in 23 seconds to pass Hockey Guy, and the clock says no. The church has nobody left and needs a miracle no scoreboard can deliver. Unless the stat crew rewrites the night, Torn-Again Christian is projected for the chopping block. Somebody hand the choir one last hymn.

articles.headline: Seven Left, One Axe: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Opens Week 12 Parked on the Launch Pad
paras: Twenty started. Seven remain. And the Week 12 race leaves the gate on a Wednesday night, folks, with the whole field staring at a scoreboard full of zeros. Projected last? [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]], at 112.8 and a 28% Chop%, with [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] breathing down the same exhaust pipe at 114.2 and 26%.

First blood goes to [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]]. [[p:8167|Christian Watson (WR, GB, #9)]] hauled in one catch for 6 yards, and that 1.1 is the only number on the board in the whole league. A man at the wrong arena, holding the lead. I can't believe it either.

Still to come tonight in Q1: SkyWalker's rocket fuel, [[p:12501|Matthew Golden (WR, GB, #0)]], lines up on the same field as BerkIam's [[p:11586|Blake Corum (RB, LAR, #24)]] and Hockey Guy's [[p:8150|Kyren Williams (RB, LAR, #23)]]. If Golden takes off before Corum gets rolling, the two bottom ships swap seats before Thursday even boards.

articles.headline: Liftoff! [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Clears the Pad and Leaves [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] in the Smoke
paras: It happened, folks, exactly as the flight plan said. [[p:12501|Matthew Golden (WR, GB, #0)]] fired the boosters with a 39-yard catch, and [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] climbed off the launch pad and out of last place. Down into the basement slides [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]], now projected last at 109.4 with a 36% Chop%, up from 26% an hour ago.

The turn? [[p:11586|Blake Corum (RB, LAR, #24)]] has six carries for 19 yards, good for 1.9, and nobody's ignition. Meanwhile the man at the wrong arena has found the right rink. [[p:8167|Christian Watson (WR, GB, #9)]] scored a touchdown, [[p:8150|Kyren Williams (RB, LAR, #23)]] scored one too, and [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] rockets from fifth to second with 27.1, the Chop% melting to 2%.

Still live in Q2: Corum against Golden, and a projected gap of just 1.8 points between the bottom two ships. BerkIam keeps six starters in the hangar, Thursday through Sunday night. One Corum run into the end zone and SkyWalker is back on the pad before the turkey is carved.

articles.headline: Corum Grounds the Rocket: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Back on the Pad Before the Turkey
paras: Told you, folks, and he didn't even need the end zone. [[p:11586|Blake Corum (RB, LAR, #24)]] just kept pounding: 14 carries, 57 yards, six points since the last chapter. That was enough to lift [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] off the floor and drop [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] right back onto the launch pad. SkyWalker is now projected last at 107.6, Chop% up to 40. BerkIam exhales to 25.

Mission control, the fuel line is frozen. [[p:12501|Matthew Golden (WR, GB, #0)]] still sits on that one 39-yard catch. And the man at the wrong arena? [[p:8167|Christian Watson (WR, GB, #9)]] and [[p:8150|Kyren Williams (RB, LAR, #23)]] have gone quiet, [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] is parked on 27.1 as the ice resurfaces, and he slips to third, Chop% ticking up to 6.

Still live at Q3 7:46: Golden against Corum, a projected gap of 5.6 points between the bottom two ships. Both crews keep six more starters in the hangar for Thursday and Sunday. SkyWalker needs Golden to outrun his projection tonight, or the countdown to the chopping block starts over a plate of stuffing.

articles.headline: Corum Hits 147 Yards and [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]]'s Rocket Is Leaking Fuel
paras: Somebody stop this man. [[p:11586|Blake Corum (RB, LAR, #24)]] is up to 29 carries, 147 yards and a touchdown: 18.9 more points since the last chapter. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] went from sixth all the way up to second, and its Chop% dropped by 20 to just 5. That's not an escape, folks, that's a jailbreak.

articles.headline: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]]'s Chop% Falls 38 Without Scoring a Single Point

articles.headline: Still Grounded: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Idles While [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] Starts to Sweat
paras: The rocket hasn't moved an inch. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] still sits on 4.9 points, dead last, yet the Chop% slipped to 39. Why? Because the neighbors got nervous. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] climbed to 7.0 points, but its Chop% jumped to 22 as the projections soured.

articles.headline: Detroit Clears the Table; [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Still Waiting on the Launch Pad
paras: The pie-eating contest is over, and [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]] ate the whole bakery: 205 rushing yards, three touchdowns, 48.7 points for [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]]. articles.headline: Liftoff, Barely: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Clears the Pad as [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Trips
paras: We have ignition! Sort of. [[p:8137|George Pickens (WR, DAL, #3)]] hauled in one 36-yard catch and [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] finally left the launch pad, up to 9.5 points. articles.headline: Halftime Boarding Call: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Sputters, [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Loses Altitude
paras: It's halftime, and the rocket to nowhere is selling a second ticket. articles.headline: Lamb Chops the Gap: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Pulls Up, [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Still Sputtering
paras: Fourth quarter, and somebody found the throttle. It was not the rocket. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] has crawled to 12.2, Chop% up to 44, still projected to be chopped. [[p:4866|Saquon Barkley (RB, PHI, #26)]] is still parked at five carries and 7 yards, and somebody should check the meter. Behind them, [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] handed fourth place right back to [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]], who gained it without scoring a point. Nice work if you can get it.

[[p:8137|George Pickens (WR, DAL, #3)]] has one quarter left to be SkyWalker's engine, and then the hangar is dark until Sunday. outsiderightfoot still has [[p:4984|Josh Allen (QB, BUF, #17)]] on deck tonight. If Pickens can't light it now, SkyWalker spends the whole weekend on the launch pad, staring at the axe.

articles.headline: Liftoff! [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] Burns Off the Gap, and the Bottom Is a Coin Flip
paras: Somebody check the launch pad. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] finally fired: 15.6 on the board, Chop% down 7 to 37. And [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]], fresh out of last chapter's dive, just watched its own Chop% climb 11 to 37. That 7-point projected cushion? Gone. About 0.3 projected points now separate sixth from seventh.

The engine was [[p:8137|George Pickens (WR, DAL, #3)]], who used his last quarter for 3.4 more points and closed at 5 catches for 67 yards. Allen has the rest of tonight to rebuild the wall, and outsiderightfoot gets [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] on Friday. SkyWalker sits in the hangar until Sunday with all five starters fueled, led by [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]]. If Allen catches fire, the rocket spends the weekend staring at the axe again. If he doesn't, nobody knows who's on the block.

articles.headline: The Coin Lands: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Hits the Block as the Rescue Flight Stalls
paras: Last chapter the bottom was a coin flip. The coin has landed, and it landed on [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]]. Chop% up 22 to 59, down into seventh, and the insurance policy is the reason: [[p:4984|Josh Allen (QB, BUF, #17)]] is 5-for-10 for 41 yards with an interception, good for 2.1 points as the second quarter runs out. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] hasn't moved an inch in the hangar and still watched its Chop% drop 6 to 31. Best flight of the day: the one that never took off.

[[t:bmransom|bmransom]] piled up 28.8 points and vaulted from fifth to second, with [[p:8138|James Cook III (RB, BUF, #4)]] pounding in a touchdown on 19 carries and [[p:1466|Travis Kelce (TE, KC, #87)]] hauling in 4 catches for 71 yards. There is a whole second half to play. Allen is still projected for 10.8, and outsiderightfoot needs every bit of it and more: the projected gap to SkyWalker is back to about 7 points. After tonight it's [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] on Friday, then a long wait for Sunday. Can Allen rebuild the wall in two quarters, or does the rocket sleep easy all weekend?

articles.headline: Claim Pending: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]]'s Insurance Policy Starts Running
paras: Two quarters to rebuild the wall, and the wall is still rubble. [[p:4984|Josh Allen (QB, BUF, #17)]] has thrown a second interception and sits 9-of-19 for 70 yards. So he stopped throwing and started running: six carries, 41 yards, and he has clawed up to 6.9 points with 11:58 left. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] gained 4.8 this hour and still ticked up to a 59 Chop%. The rocket, meanwhile, slept. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] scored nothing and slid to 30 anyway.

Same game, different planet, again. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] keeps feasting: [[p:13337|Emmett Johnson (RB, KC, #10)]] punched in a touchdown for 11 points this hour, and [[p:8138|James Cook III (RB, BUF, #4)]] has 21.7 on 28 carries. Second place, 81.1 points, and a Chop% that rounds to zero.

Allen is projected for only 3.3 more, and the projected gap to SkyWalker is 8.0 points. The relief is a day away: [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] runs Friday, projected for 19.4, then the long wait for Sunday. Can Coleman outrun a spaceship parked in its hangar, or does the policy finally lapse?

articles.headline: Turkey Day Feast: [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnom]] Eats, [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Files a Claim
paras: The plates are cleared, the parade is over, and the insurance policy is still in force. Barely. [[p:6786|CeeDee Lamb (WR, DAL, #88)]] did his part with 134 yards on seven catches, but the rest of the stuffing never arrived.

The holiday belonged to the hungry. [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] did exactly what the name promised: 81.5 points in one day, led by [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]] and his 205 rushing yards, three touchdowns and 49.2 points. That leaves a projected 10.6-point gap over outsiderightfoot, and SkyWalker's Chop% drifted down to 25. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] has not scored a point and does not care: seven starters to come, projected for 127.4. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] added 7.7 and waits at 38.7 with five to play.

Last chapter asked whether [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] could outrun a spaceship parked in its hangar. Friday is the answer. Coleman is projected for 19.4, and then the claims department has three more starters on Sunday. Ten projected points of rocket fuel separate the policyholder from the next team up. The adjuster opens the window tomorrow night.

articles.headline: Black Friday Doorbuster: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Shops for Points at 74 Chop%
paras: Black Friday, and the claims department is first in line at the doorbuster. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] still sits last of seven on 28.1, and its Chop% jumped 9 overnight to 74. articles.headline: Claim Denied: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Climbs to 82 Chop% as Coleman Inches
paras: The doorbuster line got longer, folks. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] crept up to 31.7 points, still last of seven, and somehow its Chop% jumped another 9 to 82. articles.headline: Small Claims Court: Coleman Files 7.4, [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Still at 83 Chop%
paras: The Black Friday line hasn't budged, folks. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] shuffled up to 35.5 points and is still last of seven, and the Chop% ticked up again to 83. Up in orbit, [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] sits at 13 without firing a single engine. The projected gap is 20.0 points, about what the adjuster quoted last hour.

The premiums did get bigger. [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] now has 14 carries for 25 yards and five catches for 19 more, worth 7.4 points at Q3 3:22. That's 3.8 since the last chapter. It's a real claim, but it's small claims court, and his projection has him finishing at 12.4.

So the case still goes to Sunday. outsiderightfoot has [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] and [[p:8144|Chris Olave (WR, NO, #12)]] in the early games and a tight end on Sunday night, projected to finish at 84.4. SkyWalker has all five starters still on the launch pad, projected to land at 104.4. For the next chapter to flip, Coleman needs a fourth quarter that turns a fender-bender into a total loss.

articles.headline: Claim Closed at 12.7: [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] Leaves Black Friday Still at 83%
paras: The Black Friday doorbusters are over, folks, and the adjuster has stamped the file. [[p:13345|Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN, #20)]] went the distance: 15 carries for 26 yards and eight catches for 46 more, good for 12.7 points. It was the only real money anyone in our league banked today, and it all went to [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]].

Last chapter asked Coleman to turn a fender-bender into a total loss. He got the fourth quarter he needed for 5.3 more points, but the car is still drivable. outsiderightfoot climbs to 40.8, still last of seven, and the Chop% barely blinked: it sits at 83. The projected gap to [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]] narrows to 19.8 points, a dent, not a rescue.

Elsewhere the mall stayed closed. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] scraped together 1.0 point, and the rest of the field, SkyWalker, [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]], [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]], [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] and [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnom]], didn't ring up a thing. Nobody got hurt, nobody got paid, and the leaderboard went home with its leftovers.

Up in orbit, SkyWalker is still parked at 15.6 with all five starters on the launch pad, projected to land at 104.4 and a 13% Chop%. ZynFree hasn't scored at all and doesn't care: seven starters to come, projected to finish 127.5.

So the case goes to Sunday. outsiderightfoot sends [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] and [[p:8144|Chris Olave (WR, NO, #12)]] into the early games, with a tight end on Sunday night, projected to finish at 84.6. To flip this saga, Henry and Olave need to file the kind of claim that bankrupts the insurer, or the rocket needs a launch-pad explosion. Until then, the policy stays in force and the axe stays sharpened.
